definition.en: A body that produces energy in its interior and shines by its own light; the Sun is one.
definition.zh: 内部产生能量并自己发光的天体，太阳就是一颗恒星。

definition.en: Here, one of the eight major bodies orbiting the Sun; unlike a star, it is seen mainly by reflected light.
definition.zh: 本主题指绕太阳运行的八颗主要行星之一，主要靠反射光被看见。

definition.en: The Sun and the bodies bound to it by gravity.
definition.zh: 太阳和受它引力束缚的天体组成的系统。

definition.en: The path of one body moving around another.
definition.zh: 天体绕另一天体运动的路径。

definition.en: The movement of a body around another body.
definition.zh: 天体围绕另一天体的运动。

definition.en: A natural body orbiting a planet or another larger body.
definition.zh: 绕行星或其他较大天体运动的天然天体。

definition.en: A relatively small rocky body in the solar system.
definition.zh: 太阳系里较小的岩质天体。

definition.en: An icy dusty body that can release a coma and tails when heated near the Sun.
definition.zh: 含冰与尘埃、靠近太阳受热时可能形成彗发与彗尾的天体。

definition.en: A class including Pluto: a nearly round solar-system body orbiting the Sun that has not cleared its orbital neighbourhood and is not a moon.
definition.zh: 包括冥王星的一类天体：绕太阳运行、形状近圆、没有清除轨道附近其他天体，也不是卫星。

definition.en: A defined length of exactly 149,597,870,700 metres, useful for planetary distances.
definition.zh: 精确定为 149,597,870,700 米的长度单位，适合描述行星距离。

definition.en: A change of light direction as optical conditions change along its path.
definition.zh: 光经过不同光学条件时，传播方向发生改变。

definition.en: A named, bounded area of the sky; the familiar drawn figure is a related imagined pattern.
definition.zh: 有名称与边界的天区；其中熟悉的连线图形是想象出来的相关图案。

definition.en: The local dividing direction between the sky above and directions below.
definition.zh: 本地天空上方与下方方向的分界。

definition.en: The distance light travels through vacuum in one year, approximately 9.46 trillion kilometres.
definition.zh: 光在真空中一年走过的距离，约 9.46 万亿千米。

definition.en: The barred spiral galaxy containing the Sun and solar system.
definition.zh: 包含太阳与太阳系的棒旋星系。

definition.en: A large system of stars and other matter held together by gravity.
definition.zh: 由引力维系、含大量恒星及其他物质的大型系统。
